jcr:content.jcr:title: Anamnesis Cloud
jcr:content.jcr:description: Anamnesis Cloud - interactive knowledge graphs for AI-assisted coding.

hero.title: Interactive Knowledge Graphs for AI-Assisted Coding
hero.subtitle: Build, upload, and visualize code architecture from VS Code. Let AI agents query your graph before searching files - across TypeScript, Java, AEM, Maven, Apache, NGINX, and more.

cards_why.title: Why Anamnesis?
cards_why.subtitle: AI coding agents grep blindly through files. Anamnesis gives them a knowledge graph - files, classes, functions, imports, and calls - so they understand architecture before they search.

item0.description: Multiple extractors run in parallel. One graph per project links code, config, build, and documentation layers.

item1.description: Graphs are stored on Anamnesis Cloud. Browse projects, share with your team, and query from VS Code or Cursor.

item2.description: Enable MCP + Cursor skill so agents use list_projects, query_graph, impact_of_change, and more before reading files.

cards_features.title: Key Features
cards_features.subtitle: Everything you need to understand and navigate complex codebases.

item0.description: Right-click any workspace folder and generate a unified knowledge graph. One graph per project, uploaded to Anamnesis Cloud.

item1.description: Browse all your graphs from the Anamnesis activity bar. Open owned and shared company projects instantly.

item2.description: Fast Table view for large graphs with text filtering, plus Cytoscape graph view with force-directed, circle, grid, concentric, and preset layouts.

item3.description: Inspect label, kind, community, source file, line number, and neighbors. Click any node to jump to source code.

item4.description: Enable AI Tools to register an MCP server and Cursor skill so agents query the graph before searching files.

item5.description: TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Maven, HTL/AEM, AEM Content XML, HTML, Apache, NGINX, Bash, Jenkins, and Markdown architecture docs.

item6.description: Understand blast radius before editing. Trace dependencies, callers, callees, and shortest paths across your codebase.

item7.description: Configure server URL, credentials, default tag, and test connection. Works with Anamnesis Cloud or local development.
